svg.title: Диаграмма классов: сервисный слой, модули и интеграции

g.text: Диаграмма классов: сервисный слой, модули и интеграции
AttendanceCalculator — чистые функции без БД (тестируются без Django, ЛР6).
Время передаётся в сервисы через IClock, в правила — параметром now (подмена в тестах).
+on_resolve_dispute(chat_id: str, dispute_id: int, fix: bool, comment: str)
+build_services(clock: IClock = None, channel: INotificationChannel = None): Services
+allowed_misses(total: int, missed: int, threshold_percent: int): int
+calculate(lessons: list[Lesson], records: list[AttendanceRecord], threshold_percent: int, now: datetime): AttendanceStats
+can_mark(user: Student, lesson: Lesson, now: datetime): bool
+can_edit(user: Student, record: AttendanceRecord, now: datetime): bool
+can_assign_delegate(grantor: Student, delegate: Student, now: datetime): bool
+save_marks(user: Student, lesson_id: int, marks: dict[int, AttendanceStatus], reason: str): None
+correct_record(actor: Student, record_id: int, new_status: AttendanceStatus, reason: str, source: ChangeSource): None
+set_absence_reason(student: Student, record_id: int, text: str): None
+create(student: Student, record_id: int, comment: str): Dispute
+resolve(resolver: Student, dispute_id: int, fix: bool, comment: str): None
+set_threshold(teacher: Teacher, course_id: int, percent: int): None
+for_student(student: Student, from_: datetime, to: datetime): list[AttendanceStats]
+for_course(teacher: Teacher, course: Course, from_: datetime, to: datetime): CourseReport
+notify(recipient: Student, type: NotificationType, text: str): None
+notify_headmen(group_id: int, type: NotificationType, text: str): None
